name: Orders of Bauron
description: The Awakened: • Blessing of the Night Watch. For one year, during the night, the pilgrim receives a +1 bonus to attack rolls against aberrations or beings from the Penumbral Plane. The Heralds: • Blessing of Truth. For one year, when speaking with pure sincerity and devoid of ulterior motives, the pilgrim gains a +1d4 bonus to Persuasion checks. The Inquisition: • Blessing of Suspicion. The pilgrim is granted a +1d4 bonus to Insight checks for one year, but only when trying to discern if someone is lying. The Spiritual Guides: • Blessing of the Spirit Warden. For one year, the pilgrim is shielded from forces beyond the grave, gaining advantage on saving throws against necromancy spells and all effects imposed by undead beings. Farmers often ask for the Blessing of Nature, while city-dwelling commoners and bureaucrats tend to ask for the Blessing of Truth or the Blessing of Suspicion. Artists and artisans often desire the Blessing of Inspiration, while the adventurers and mercenaries go for the Blessing of the Night Watch, Blessing of Light, or Blessing of Health. and agelessness within the forest’s bounds. Some druids, Tanares’ oldest humans, have lived over a thousand years. However, dark times have descended upon Bak. A sinister plague, supposedly the doing of the Cult of Shadow Wing, corrupts its flora and fauna into aberrations. While Imperial Wizards believe a corrupted artifact might be the source, their motives are questioned by the druids who deny them entry to the forest’s heart. Rumors are that the wizards harbor hidden agendas, seeking to uncover the druid’s secrets to learn how and negate their magical protections. Further complicating matters, a group of afflicted elves from Eastern Bak aim to penetrate deeper into the forest. The druids, wary of their sacred ponds being infected by the plague, stand in their path, while these elves blame the druids’ prolonged lifespans for nature’s imbalance and the consequent plague. In the past, the druids have kept adventurers at bay. But with the forest now under siege, they beckon outsiders to help against plague-created aberrations and help to unearth a cure.
